name: Fire Breath
effect: The user gains access to the following weapon profile twice per day: \columnbreak \begin{sitemize} \item Shots: 3 \item Damage: 1D10+2 \item Range: 4m \item Flame, Scatter, Spray \end{sitemize} It uses Ranged Combat Training (Integrated Weaponry).
_comment: columnbreak in effect is a dirty quick fix and may break formatting in the future

name: Hematophagia
effect: The user may drink untreated blood to substitute water and food consumption. Poison and extremely heavy pollutants may still cause poisoning.

name: Reactive Resilience Layer
effect: When taking a defensive stance, the user may make a free toughness test to reduce the damage of an incoming hit by its DoS. The user takes a level of exhaustion per hit taken.

name: Smoke Vents
effect: cause a Blast (3), Smoke effect around the character up to once a day

name: Tail Spike
effect: allows a new combat action: tail attack (unarmed attack with piercing quality; is at -10 to evade); if the character also has Venom Sacs, the attack applies this toxin; resistance is at an additional -10
mods: Cheap, Integrated Weaponry, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Wrongly fitted, Compartment

name: Venom Sacs
effect: Produces and stores one type of chemical. Which chemicals are available is up to the GM. \\% It produces one dose per week and stores up to 3 at a time. If more are produced than can be stored, the user suffers its effects, detriments and overdose effects.
mods: Integrated Weaponry (ranged weapon with spray rule), Perfect fit, Wrongly fitted
